g.text: C2 (Jacobian) is ORDER-BLIND — |det| = ∏|det Cᵢ| regardless of composition order. C3 (cover) is IMAGE-based — a set, order-tolerant.
So C1+C2+C3 all passed GREEN / clean-three over a chart fold that was BOTH leaf-first AND α-under-implemented. A green build would have shipped.
Only C4 (the loss LOWER BOUND) reads the actual diagonal — it is the SOLE order- and gauge-sensitive consumer. It is the true gate,
and building it is what surfaced the fracture below. Lesson (calibration 15/16/19/20): a clean build is necessary, never sufficient;
the value-sensitive consumer + the decorrelated hunt are the instruments — and here they caught a WRONG-RLCT spine before it shipped.

suffix sum (M). So the α completion is the SHARED linchpin — and it is NATIVE to a root-first-from-the-start build, never in-place.
